translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Ngeche mag Solomon wuod Daudi, ruodh Israel:

content.text: mamiyo iyudo rieko kod ritruok makare,
kendo winjo tiend weche matut;
kendo miyo idak e ngima moritore kendo mobidhore
kitimo gima adiera kendo gima kare kendo mowinjore,
gimiyo joma ngʼeyogi tin bedo mariek,
kendo gimiyo jomatindo ngʼeyo tiend weche kendo pogo tiend wach.
Mad jomariek chik itgi mondo owinji kendo gimedgi e puonjruokgi,
to jogo mongʼeyo pogo tiend wach mad oyud gino ma chikogi,
mondo gingʼe ngeche, sigendini,
kod weche ma tiendgi tek mag jorieko.
Luoro Jehova Nyasaye e chakruok mar ngʼeyo
to joma ofuwo chayo rieko gi ritruok makare.
Wuoda, chik iti ni puonj wuonu,
kendo kik ijwangʼ puonj mar minu.
Ginibedni kaka kondo michwowo e wiyi,
kendo kaka thiwni miketo e ngʼuti mondo ineri maber.
Wuoda, ka joricho hoyoi mondo itim marach,
kik iyienegi.
Kagiwachoni niya, “Bi idhi kodwa;
mondo wabuti ni ngʼato wanegi,
kendo wamonj kayiem nono joma onge ketho;
mondo wamuonygi ngili ka bur liel
mana ka joma omwony mangima gi bur;
wabiro yudo gik moko duto mabeyo ma nengogi tek,
mi wapongʼ utewa gi gik moyaki.
In bende riwri kodwa e wachni,
kendo wanapog gigo duto mwayako.”
Wuoda, kik idhi kodgi ngangʼ
kendo kik iwuoth e yoregigo,
nikech tiendgi reto piyo piyo mar timo richo
kendo gimwomore mondo gichwer remo.
Mano kaka en gima nono chiko obadho
ka winy duto neno.
Jogi ochiko obadho ne gin giwegi,
kendo gin ema ginimokie!
Mano e giko jogo duto mohero yudo gimoro moyud e yo marach;
gino kawo ngima jogo moyude.
Rieko goyo koko matek e yore mag dala,
ogoyo koko bende e kuonde chokruok;
oywak kogoyo koko e akerkeke mag yore motimo koko,
owuoyo e dhorangeye mag mier madongo kopenjo niya,
“Nyaka karangʼo ma un joma ngʼeyogi tin nusik kuhero yoreu mag ngʼeyo matin?”
Nyaka karangʼo ma jojaro pod nosik kamor,
e jaro kendo joma ofuwo nosiki kochayo puonj?
Ka dine uwinj siem mara,
dine abedo kodu thuolo,
kendo damiyo ungʼeyo pacha.
To nikech ne udaga kane aluongo
kendo onge ngʼama nodewa kane adwaro konyou,
nimar ne udagi puonj maga duto
kendo ne ok uwinjo siem mara.
An to ananyieru bangʼe ka un e chandruok;
Anajaru ajara ka masira oloyou,
ka masira machalo yamb ahiti obiro kuomu,
kendo ka chandruok oyweyou ka yamb kalausi.
Ka lit kod thagruok ohingou.
Giniluonga, to ok anadwokgi;
ginimanya to ok giniyuda.
Kaka ne ok gidwar puonj
kendo ok negiyiero luoro Jehova Nyasaye,
Kaka ne ok giyie gi puonjna
kendo gidagi siem mara,
kuom mano ginicham olemo mag yoregi
kendo giniyiengʼ gi olemo mar riekogi maricho.
Nikech yore mobam mag bayo mag jogo mangʼeyogi tin noneg-gi,
kendo bedo ma ok odewo gimoro mar joma ofuwo notiekgi.
To ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wachna nodag gi kwe
kendo mayom, maonge luoro mar hinyruok.
